entities.name: Lukka
entities.description: A red-aligned human bonder and planeswalker from Ikoria, a former Coppercoat who was compleated on New Phyrexia and later killed by Vadrok and Vivien Reid.

entities.name: Phyrexian Lukka
entities.description: The compleated version of Lukka, fused with Rothga into a titanic, many-mouthed humanoid who assimilates monsters and defenders.

entities.name: Ikoria
entities.description: Lukka's home plane of monsters and bonders.

entities.name: Drannith
entities.description: The human city of Ikoria where Lukka grew up, which he attacks and destroys.

entities.name: Coppercoats
entities.description: An elite military squad that protects Ikoria's human cities from monsters.

entities.name: First Special Intercept Squad
entities.description: A small incident reaction team of the Coppercoats that Lukka commanded.

entities.name: Jirina Kudro
entities.description: The daughter of the Coppercoat general, once engaged to Lukka, who takes command of Drannith's defenses and leads the convoy.

entities.name: General Kudro
entities.description: The general of the Coppercoats and Jirina's father, killed by Lukka; he executed Leori.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker who befriends Lukka, persuades him to join the strike on New Phyrexia and later shoots his Phyrexian form.

entities.name: Leori
entities.description: A large winged patagia tiger and Lukka's first bonded companion, executed by General Kudro.

entities.name: Mila
entities.description: A grey, spotted, fire-breathing fox-like creature that Lukka bonds with on Arcavios.

entities.name: Rothga
entities.description: A Phyrexian beast that Lukka bonds with on New Phyrexia and that fuses with him upon compleation.

entities.name: The Ozolith
entities.description: A crystalline formation in Ikoria's north used by an unnamed planeswalker to cause bondings and monster rage, which empowers and unbalances Lukka.

entities.name: Unnamed planeswalker of the Ozolith
entities.description: A meddling planeswalker who manipulated Ikoria through the Ozolith and warned Lukka of its consequences; only his voice appears.

entities.name: Battle at the Ozolith
entities.description: The clash at the Ozolith during which Lukka touched the crystal.

entities.name: Siege of Drannith
entities.description: Lukka's monster army attack on Drannith.

entities.name: Vadrok
entities.description: An apex monster of Ikoria whose magical fire destroys Lukka's Phyrexian form.

entities.name: Chevill
entities.description: An ally who helps Vivien Reid set a trap for Lukka.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane of Strixhaven where Lukka travels after fleeing Ikoria.

entities.name: Oriq
entities.description: Dark mages of Arcavios led by Extus Narr whom Lukka helps against Strixhaven.

entities.name: Extus Narr
entities.description: Leader of the Oriq who knows planeswalkers and proposes a trade with Lukka.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The magical university of Arcavios that Lukka distrusts.

entities.name: Dragonsguard
entities.description: Strixhaven forces who fight the Oriq.

entities.name: Kasmina
entities.description: A figure Lukka distracts as part of the Oriq attack on Strixhaven.

entities.name: Founder Dragons
entities.description: The dragons who turn the tide at Strixhaven.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who recruits Lukka for the strike on New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: Phyrexian ruler of New Phyrexia who sends Lukka back to conquer Ikoria.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian-ruled plane where Lukka is compleated.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker stranded with Lukka in the Hunter Maze, who is later compleated.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: A Phyrexian who orders Lukka to capture Nissa alive.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: A Phyrexian Lukka fights in the Hunter Maze.

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: A figure who intervenes to buy Nissa time to escape.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A Phyrexian figure who doubts Lukka's chances of conquering Ikoria.

entities.name: The Vicious Swarm
entities.description: A Phyrexian group whose Darwinism appeals to Lukka and which compleats him.

entities.name: Teferi Akosa
entities.description: A planeswalker Lukka has met.

events.summary: Bullied by five older boys as a youth, Lukka later takes revenge on each of them.
events.quote: He later exacted revenge on each of them.

events.summary: After bonding with Leori, Lukka is dishonorably discharged from the Specials, banned from Drannith and made an outcast.
events.quote: Lukka was dishonorably discharged from the Specials, banned from Drannith, and made an outcast.

events.summary: Vivien Reid rescues and befriends Lukka, and they theorize he can neutralize the Ozolith.
events.quote: She rescued Lukka from his pursuers and befriended him.

events.summary: At the Battle at the Ozolith Lukka touches the crystal, gains great but unbalanced power, forms an army of beasts and kills General Kudro, and Jirina attacks him and flees.
events.quote: As Kudro refused to listen, Lukka killed him.

events.summary: Lukka's army attacks Drannith in the Siege of Drannith but Jirina's strategy and the bonders turn the tide.
events.quote: Lukka and his army attacked the city, starting the Siege of Drannith

events.summary: The Ozolith explodes when Lukka ignores the unknown planeswalker's warning, igniting his spark as he planeswalks away.
events.quote: Lukka refused to listen and the Ozolith exploded, causing his planeswalker's spark to ignite as he planeswalked away.

events.summary: Lukka awakes in a swamp on another world, controls one of the beasts there and vows to return home.
events.quote: Lukka vowed to one day return home.

events.summary: On Arcavios Lukka bonds with Mila, is captured by the Oriq and meets their leader Extus Narr, who offers a trade.
events.quote: Extus explained that there were things he could teach Lukka and proposed a trade.

events.summary: Lukka helps the Oriq by distracting Kasmina and coordinating an attack on Strixhaven, then leaves when the Founder Dragons turn the tide.
events.quote: when the tide was turned by the Founder Dragons , Lukka quickly left the battlefield

events.summary: Jace and Vivien persuade Lukka to join the Mirrans' strike on New Phyrexia, promising he could return home a hero.
events.quote: Lukka initially refused, but was eventually convinced by Vivien Reid

events.summary: Stranded with Nissa in the Hunter Maze, Lukka forms the eludha with a Phyrexian beast, beginning his poisoning and susceptibility to compleation.
events.quote: made the mistake of forming the eludha with a Phyrexian beast

events.summary: Lukka is compleated, fully merging with his companion, and Glissa orders him to capture Nissa alive.
events.quote: By the time he fought Glissa and Vorinclex , he fully bonded with his companion and the two became one.

events.summary: As the New Phyrexian Invasion begins, Elesh Norn sends Lukka to conquer Ikoria by subverting its monsters.
events.quote: Elesh Norn sent Lukka back to Ikoria to conquer his homeplane.

events.summary: Lukka destroys Drannith, leaving survivors who flee toward Lavabrink, and compleats monsters on the way; Vivien and Chevill's trap fails.
events.quote: Lukka first destroyed Drannith , leaving a convoy of survivors that fled for Lavabrink .

events.summary: Jirina bluffs and leads the survivors and Lukka into Vadrok's lair, where Vadrok's fire destroys him and Vivien's arrows and Vadrok finish him.
events.quote: Vadrok's magical fire obliterated Lukka's massive form
